items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: That was after our time. Yeah. We were there first.

ctx.x: And I believe Paul Bartman was a drummer then after you left.
Paul Bartman, yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, yeah. That was after our time. Yeah. We were there first.
They had a little bit bigger band. You only had four pieces there.
